title: Check list
description: A list of short statements on a solid plate, checked one by one: with progress (keyframed on the words) every row waits muted and lights up with its tick; with each row's at, rows slide in at their time. For the checks a video passes, steps completed, claims made one by one. Optional heading; sizes are a share of the frame's short side, with a floor. Takes a theme.

items.description: Each row and the item time (s) it appears at

size.description: Row size in % of the frame's short side

progress.description: Rows shown (row i is in when progress passes i + 1); keyframe it, anchored to words, to bring rows in on what is said. -1: use the at of each row

author: claude-opus-5-5
note: With progress every row is on the plate from the start, muted, and lights up with its tick: an empty plate waited for the first word.
